rules.cta_destination: the approved landing / sales page for the current approved offer version
rules.timing_rule: anchored to launch_calendar.doors_close_at in the approved launch plan: E1 at doors_close_at minus 48 hours, E2 at doors_close_at minus 24 hours, E3 in the final hours of the closing day; no other timing is invented
rules.deadline_source: launch_calendar.doors_close_at and launch_calendar.timezone from the approved launch plan, read by field name and never retyped from memory
rules.deadline_rule: every deadline, date, countdown, or closing-time line states launch_calendar.doors_close_at and its timezone exactly as approved; all three emails state the same single deadline; the close time is repeated, never extended, rounded, or restated as a different time
deadline_forbidden: a second or different close date
relative urgency that implies a different close time (midnight tonight, end of day, last chance today) when doors_close_at says otherwise
fake price changes, bonus expiry, or seat counts the brief does not state
a countdown computed from anything except doors_close_at
rules.deadline_missing_policy: fail closed: with no launch_calendar.doors_close_at there is no truthful deadline to state, so the unit does not generate; it reports the missing calendar field instead of writing urgency copy
rules.objective_note: the frozen objective enum has no doors-closing value; this profile defaults to promotional and must never widen the enum from a lane file

variant_pairing.pairing: subject and preview are paired per variant (Pair A = subject A + preview A; Pair B = subject B + preview B); pairs are preserved through the Skill-44 draft handoff, never flattened into unpaired lists
variant_pairing.pair_b_style: prolific and disruptive, truthful and on brand (no false account alert, no fake reply prefix, no fabricated urgency, no misleading price, no fake scarcity, no invented deadline)

rules.intake: the approved S49 shared-launch brief, consumed by the launch intake adapter with per-field provenance; the legacy one-block questionnaire applies only in explicit legacy interactive mode
rules.review_labels: the private client-review document labels each email with its framework and labels the body 'Email Body:'; the recipient payload carries no framework labels, slot instructions, or production commentary
rules.trigger: Signature Launch build: the three doors-closing emails are written from the approved launch brief, the approved landing page, and launch_calendar.doors_close_at; they run only inside the final 48 hours before doors close, after the main launch 10, and every CTA points at the approved landing / sales page
rules.registration_note: not yet in catalog-index.json / catalog-built-index.json and not yet in SEQ_LENGTHS / PREVIEW_EXPECTED / _sequence_type; until the integrator registers the profile, a run resolving sequence_type signature_launch_doors_closing fails AF-EMAIL-TYPE-MISMATCH by design
